entries.name: receiving-instant-default-on-any-input
entries.claim: Only an instant input asked once starts at the current instant; the validator refuses a default now on any other input.

test.namePattern: an instant input starts now only when asked once

kills.name: RECEIVING-EXTRAS: an instant input starts now only when asked once, a negated value takes back a quantity into a written field, and a step writes only a relation its page names

entries.name: receiving-negated-any-input
entries.claim: Only a quantity input is negated, and only into a field a step writes; any other negated binding is refused by name.

test.namePattern: an instant input starts now only when asked once

kills.name: RECEIVING-EXTRAS: an instant input starts now only when asked once, a negated value takes back a quantity into a written field, and a step writes only a relation its page names

entries.name: receiving-record-relation-unnamed
entries.claim: A step writes a relation of its record only when the page names that relation in a column or a link, so the record's get states it.

test.namePattern: an instant input starts now only when asked once

kills.name: RECEIVING-EXTRAS: an instant input starts now only when asked once, a negated value takes back a quantity into a written field, and a step writes only a relation its page names

entries.name: receiving-incoming-without-output
entries.claim: A List supply states incoming supply exactly when it sums it: incoming without its output, or the output without incoming, is refused by name.

test.namePattern: a List supply sums what placed purchase orders still have to receive

kills.name: RECEIVING-EXTRAS: a List supply sums what placed purchase orders still have to receive, stated exactly when it is summed

entries.name: receiving-received-date-starts-empty
entries.claim: A receive Task's received date starts at the request clock's now, in the explicit-UTC picker, until a value is submitted.

test.namePattern: a truck receipt receives several lines in one receipt

kills.name: ORDER-PARITY: a truck receipt receives several lines in one receipt, filled from what is open, one request key per run
kills.expected: the received date starts at the request clock

entries.name: receiving-correction-adds-what-was-entered
entries.claim: Correct receipt writes each line as the negative of the quantity entered on it, so a correction takes stock back rather than receiving it again.

test.namePattern: a receipt page takes back part of a posted receipt

kills.name: RECEIVING-EXTRAS: a receipt page takes back part of a posted receipt, line by line, through the receiving routes, and a refused post reads in plain language
kills.expected: the correction line takes back what was entered

entries.name: receiving-refusals-unreadable
entries.claim: The posting kernel's date, period, correction and order-state refusals read in plain language, each naming the kernel's code as its subject.

test.namePattern: refusals read in plain language and keep their code

kills.name: RECEIVING-EXTRAS: the posting kernel’s date and receiving refusals read in plain language and keep their code

entries.name: receiving-list-short-ignores-incoming
entries.claim: The Sales orders List states as short only what neither free stock nor placed purchase orders still to arrive cover, before the count, the page and the export.

kills.name: an item short of free stock but on a placed purchase order reads On order, not short, on the List and the order page
kills.expected: nine reads its Short on the List

entries.name: receiving-page-short-ignores-incoming
entries.claim: The order page states each line's shortage net of what placed purchase orders still to arrive cover, allocated in line order, as the List does.

kills.name: an item short of free stock but on a placed purchase order reads On order, not short, on the List and the order page
kills.expected: nine reads its Short on its page
